$comment: Knowledge Engine — KB-2 (UI Component Knowledge) record. Frozen at major 1 from the reviewed issue #7 draft (only the $id path changed). LICENSE-BOUNDED INTENT: this schema exposes metadata fields only, with no dedicated source/template/CSS/JS/asset/license-key payload fields; free-text values still require strict ingestion/export sanitization and negative tests against code, key and sensitive-data leakage (ingest enforces a deterministic size cap on licensed-package records). Licensed packages (Hyvä UI) are recorded as metadata + version-pinned path pointers only. The three audited UI sources are distinct records distinguished by sourcePackage.kind, linked by relation records (mapsTo/adaptedFrom WITHIN the developer-owned class; neighborOf across to Page Builder native) — equivalents are never merged or counted three times. 'other' exists for future sources.
title: Knowledge Engine — KB-2 UI Component record

id.$comment: Version-free toolkit id, e.g. 'uic:hyva-ui:hero', 'uic:secomm-uiwidget:banner-a', 'uic:page-builder-native:banner'. nativeId preserves the upstream identifier ('hero/A-default', 'banner_a', 'banner').

nativeId.$comment: Upstream identifier exactly as declared: Hyvä UI 'component/variant', widget registry id, PB content type id.

kind.$comment: The three audited sources are first-class kinds (contract vocabulary from the accepted #7 audit — VALUES, not core-code coupling); 'other' exists for future sources and must be justified in notes.

locator.$comment: rootAlias-relative pointer to the package root. Never an absolute owner path in shared stores.

concept.$comment: UX-semantic mapping target (issue #7 vocabulary). Non-exhaustive: additive minors only. 'other' requires description.

notSupported.$comment: Explicit: what this component does NOT support. Prevents inventing a component later.

state.$comment: Four distinct states (audit-verified vocabulary). available-upstream implies nothing about use. Use usageLinks to express multi-state reality instead of duplicating records.

eligibility.$comment: Eligibility-matrix disposition for widget candidates; reason goes to eligibilityReason.

usageLinks.$comment: How this component is actually used by the project — zero or more, never implied by availability.

refId.$comment: ID of the KB-1 capability or theme element providing the runtime rendering.

configOptions.$comment: Configurable option NAMES only. This schema deliberately has no field for option markup, defaults-with-code, or template bodies.

jsModel.$comment: Alpine CSP build is shipped in the audited theme; the ACTIVE runtime variant is config-driven and may be 'unknown' from file evidence alone.

cmsEditable.$comment: Whether the component surface is merchant-editable via CMS/Page Builder contexts. False on licensed upstream components — visual resemblance never implies editability.

dependencies.$comment: Dependency facts by identifier (plugin/package names), not code.

licenseRef.$comment: Pointer to the license document (path/URL) — never license text or keys.

derivedArtifactPolicy.$comment: Hyvä UI records are metadata-only: audit locally with authorized access; never vendor or publish source/templates/assets.
